title: Tor-independent scalar extension of a resolution of an A-K-flat complex
statement: Let R,A,B be commutative rings with R-algebra structures on A and B. Suppose Tor_i^R(A,B)=0 for every i>0 [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. Let Q be any cochain complex of A-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], K-flat over A [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Let P be an R-K-flat complex and s:P -> Q restricted to R any quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Then termwise scalar extension along R -> B [def-weil-module-base-change] sends s to a quasi-isomorphism of B-complexes. There is no boundedness assumption on P or Q, no flatness assumption on A or B, and no final coefficient algebra or cohomology model.

proof.text: Resolve B[0] by a bounded-above projective R-complex F with augmentation f. By the balanced Tor calculation, H^{-i}(A tensor_R F) is Tor_i^R(A,B); H^0 is A tensor_R B and positive cohomology vanishes. Balancedness is checked with the two filtrations on the tensor of bounded-above projective resolutions of A and B, whose diagonals are finite in each degree. The stipulated Tor vanishing therefore makes A tensor_R f a quasi-isomorphism of A-complexes. F is R-K-flat since its projective terms are flat.

The cone of A tensor_R f is acyclic. Tensor it on the right with the A-K-flat Q. Tensor-cone compatibility and the mixed associativity identification give a quasi-isomorphism Q tensor_R F -> Q tensor_R B. Signed symmetry matches the placement of Q in the acyclic-tensor definition. No boundedness of Q is needed.

For the R-K-flat P, tensoring f with P is a quasi-isomorphism. Since F is R-K-flat, tensoring the resolution s:P -> Q restricted to R with F is also a quasi-isomorphism. In the commuting square with vertical augmentation f and horizontal s, these three quasi-isomorphisms imply by two-out-of-three that s tensor_R B is a quasi-isomorphism. Tensor symmetry identifies it with the restriction of termwise extension of s to B. Exact restriction reflects the induced homology isomorphisms, hence reflects this quasi-isomorphism.

theorem scalarExtension_quasiIso_of_torIndependent_kFlat
    {R A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (hTor : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i →
      IsZero (((CategoryTheory.Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj (ModuleCat.of R A)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of R B)))
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hK : ∀ L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, L.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor L Q (MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
    (s : P ⟶ (((restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
    (hs : QuasiIso s) :
    QuasiIso (((extendScalars (algebraMap R B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map s)
